name: Conventions Extractor opens for the seeded repository
description: Navigates from the seeded repository shell to the read-only Conventions page and verifies the empty state, the separate Run Scan (enabled) and ReScan (disabled before a first scan) buttons, and that Create skill is absent, without triggering a model call.

cmd: (() => { const b = (name) => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((el) => el.textContent.trim() === name); return !!b('Run Scan') && !b('Run Scan').disabled && !!b('ReScan') && b('ReScan').disabled && !b('Create skill'); })()
steps.label: before the first scan: Run Scan enabled, ReScan disabled, no Create skill
